values.title: Post-seal horizon and information-boundary comparison
values.statement: EHT independently reconstructs a persistent horizon-scale shadow and LIGO-Virgo observes compact strong-field ringdown. Neither body directly measures the event horizon, Hawking temperature, singularity avoidance or complete information reconstruction; those distinctions remain explicit.
values.generation_rule: Generate the complete eight-axis post-seal horizon and information comparison product.
values.grammar_boundary: All registered EHT shadow, directness, LIGO strong-field and unmeasured Hawking/information rows.
values.exact_result: Horizon-scale compact strong-field shadow and ringdown support are confirmed; direct horizon imaging, normalized thermal carrier, Hawking radiation and information reconstruction remain unmeasured predictions or formal boundaries.
values.induction_base: The independent EHT shadow observations retain their reconstruction and size-consistency records.
values.induction_step: Strong-field, directness, thermal and information rows append without converting inference into direct observation.
exclusions: no claim that EHT directly photographed the event horizon
no claim that information reconstruction was observed
target_rows: complete registered NIST/CNES/LIGO-GWOSC/EHT vector with unfavorable controls
values.falsification_condition: Independent horizon-scale observations cease to support compact shadow/ringdown structure, or an indirect/model-dependent record is mislabeled as direct Hawking, horizon or information-recovery measurement.
